concerns.text: T001d computes SVD ranks on 'source matrices' (pre-merge) and saves them. FR-010 and SC-004 explicitly require measuring the subspace rank of the 'per-effect weight matrix within the CollectionLoRA adapter' (the merged artifact) to correlate with bleeding. The task delivers source ranks, not the merged adapter's effective ranks, violating the core hypothesis of FR-007/FR-010.

T001a attempts to download 5 specific LoRAs (e.g., 'lykon/dreamshaper-lora') which are single-effect adapters, not the multi-effect 'CollectionLoRA' required by FR-001 and the Plan. The task logic treats these as the target 'verified source' but they do not satisfy the 'multi-effect' constraint of the spec, forcing a fallback that renders the 'verified' path dead code.

T016a implements quantization but lacks the explicit 'Model Integrity Check' mandated by Plan Section 5 and FR-002. It logs 'Quantization Failure' but does not enforce the 'skip level' logic for LPIPS > 0.8 or similarity < 0.1 as a hard gate before saving artifacts, risking the inclusion of 'catastrophic collapse' data in the Single Source of Truth (data/results.csv).

T024 defines the Bayesian model but omits the 'posterior width analysis' required by FR-014. The task description mentions saving posterior samples but does not include the logic to calculate the HDI width and flag 'Underpowered' results if width > 0.2, leaving a critical acceptance criterion unimplemented.

T018 computes CESR but fails to explicitly implement the 'Negative Control' logic required by the Plan (Section 2, Point 2) and FR-011. It references 'Distractor References' but does not mandate the subtraction of the 'Distractor CESR' baseline to normalize the metric, risking a conflation of general fidelity loss with specific concept bleeding.
